answer.location_description: Top-right corner of the image, roughly the top 3-4 rows and columns 15-22. This is at the border of the field of view, away from the centred nodule.
answer.shortcut_type: Bright patch or marker artifact in the top-right corner
answer.mechanism: The units that push toward malignant all have coherent, strongly negative weight blocks in the top-right corner. These are the large-nodule units (16, 10, 30, 12, center-negative with a positive ring) and the broad context units 19 and 23. A bright top-right corner therefore switches them off. At the same time, the benign compact-nodule units (0, 8, 25, 5, 15, 20, 31) carry positive weights in that same corner, so the corner adds to their activation. Both effects pass through layer 2 into the output: benign units such as unit 0 feed the output negatively via layer-2 units u4, u8, u13 and u15. Malignant units such as unit 16 feed it positively via layer-2 units u0, u12, u9, u15 and others. The net result is that brightness in the top-right corner pushes the logit toward benign.
answer.evidence: Unit 16 row 0, columns 15-21: -39 -37 -40 -13 -23 -56 -45; row 2: -39 -30 -9 -30 -55 -37. Unit 10 row 0, columns 15-21: -41 -32 -40 -17 -24 -38 -52; rows 1-2 are similar. Unit 19 rows 0-2, columns 12-23 lie between -30 and -72, while the rest of the unit is mostly positive. Unit 23 rows 0-2, columns 16-23 lie between -21 and -60. Benign units have positive weights in the same corner: unit 0 at (0,20-21) = 33, 43, (2,20) = 41, (3,20) = 44; unit 8 at (0,21) = 45, (2,19-20) = 40, 41, (3,20) = 49; unit 25 at (0,20) = 41. Path products to the output: unit 16 gives about +32k in integer units (malignant), unit 0 gives about -24k (benign). Elsewhere, weights at the periphery are small and unstructured. Only this corner has a consistent, sign-opposed pattern across nearly all of the structured units, which points to a localized artifact rather than lung anatomy.
answer.main_feature: The model mainly measures nodule size and extent. Units that respond to a small, compact bright core (about rows 11-12, columns 10-13) and are inhibited by brightness in the surrounding ring push toward benign. Units that respond to a larger bright ring or extent (rows 7-9 and 14-16) push toward malignant.
